definitions.gloss: speed-reading method; technique for reading quickly
definitions.explanation: A method or set of techniques for reading text quickly while still grasping its content, such as taking in several words at a glance or not subvocalizing.

examples.japanese: {速読法|そくどくほう}を{学|まな}ぶ。
{速読法|そくどくほう}を{身|み}につけて{読|よ}む{速|はや}さが{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I picked up speed-reading techniques and my reading speed went up.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}に{大量|たいりょう}の{資料|しりょう}を{読|よ}むため、{速読法|そくどくほう}の{本|ほん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: To get through a large amount of material before the exam, I bought a book on speed reading.

notes:
Refers to the technique or training method, often marketed in books and courses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速読法|そくどくほう}を{身|み}につける: to acquire speed-reading skills
- {速読法|そくどくほう}を{練習|れんしゅう}する: to practice speed reading
- {速読法|そくどくほう}の{講座|こうざ}: a speed-reading course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {速読|そくどく}: speed reading — the activity itself, without the '-method' nuance
- {精読|せいどく}: close reading — reading slowly and carefully, the opposite approach
